topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I found it tucked away, almost hidden, behind a stack of old books. A manuscript, pages and pages filled with his handwriting. It was a novel, he said, a story of a man and a woman he clearly knew well. The woman, her life mirrored mine—a job at the clinic, the quiet evenings scrolling through recipes we’d never try. Every detail, every laugh, every quiet moment we shared, there it was, inked on paper. The room felt smaller, the air a bit heavier. I closed the notebook, the corners slightly wrinkled, and placed it back, just as I’d found it, wondering what part of my life I’d never get back once he read it, once the whole world did.
